execution_model.zh: 订单驱动：集中市场为全电子中央订单簿，依价格优先、时间优先原则逐笔撮合成交；一般股票不设做市商。仅对经交易所每年筛选的『优质低流动性股票』实施股票造市者及交易奖励参与者制度
execution_model.en: Order-driven: the centralised market is a fully electronic central order book matching order-by-order on price-then-time priority; ordinary stocks have no market makers. A Stock Market Maker and Trading Incentive Participant scheme applies only to 'quality low-liquidity stocks' selected annually by the Exchange
execution_model.detail: enum 依据既有 matching_principle（价格优先、时间优先）与 market_maker_scheme（造市制度限『优质低流动性股票』，confidence high）综合判定：一般股票为纯订单驱动，造市为补充。dealer_intermediated 记 false。

matching_principle.quote: 撮合依價格優先及時間優先原則成交，買賣申報之優先順序依下列原則決定：一 價格優先原則：較高買進申報優先於較低買進申報，較低賣出申報優先於較高賣出申報...二 時間優先原則：開市前輸入之申報，依電腦隨機排列方式決定優先順序；開市後輸入之申報，依輸入時序決定優先順序。

spec.note: 瞬间价格稳定措施：试算成交价超出前 5 分钟滚动加权平均价（9:00-9:05 以开盘价为基准）±3.5% 即暂缓该证券撮合 2 分钟，之后以集合竞价撮合；权证及新上市首 5 日无涨跌幅股票不适用

volatility_interruption.zh: 瞬间价格稳定措施：逐笔交易时段内，任一试算成交价超出「前5分钟滚动加权平均价」（9:00-9:05以开盘价为基准）上下3.5%，即暂缓该证券撮合2分钟，2分钟后以集合竞价撮合成交，其后恢复逐笔交易；权证及新上市首5日无涨跌幅股票不适用本措施
volatility_interruption.en: Instantaneous Price Stabilization Measures: continuous-auction matching is paused for 2 minutes and resumed via call auction whenever a trial price moves ±3.5% beyond the trailing 5-minute weighted average price
volatility_interruption.quote: 若有價證券之限價當日有效(限價ROD)委託於撮合前任一試算成交價超過參考價之上下3.5%，將暫緩該有價證券撮合2分鐘，於2分鐘後當盤以集合競價撮合，嗣後恢復為逐筆交易。

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 讯息面暂停/恢复交易机制（2016年1月15日起实施）：上市公司预计于交易时间内公开重大事项应主动申请暂停交易，相关讯息充分揭露后再申请恢复；另有台湾存托凭证(TDR)因所表彰证券于原上市市场公告暂停交易而联动暂停之机制
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Information-driven halt/resumption mechanism (effective since 15 Jan 2016): a listed company that expects to disclose a material matter during trading hours must proactively apply to halt trading, then apply for resumption once the information has been adequately disclosed; Taiwan Depositary Receipts (TDRs) are also halted in tandem when the underlying security is suspended on its original home market
trading_halt_mechanism.quote: 自105年1月15日起實施，規範上市公司預計於營業日交易時間內(下午5時前)公開或召開董事會決議特定重大事項時，應主動向證交所申請暫停交易，並於相關訊息充分公開或說明後，再行申請恢復交易。

spec.note: 无交易所层级的『明显错误成交作废』机制——成交一经撮合即通知委托人并制作凭证。证券经纪商受托买卖发生错误的，依《证券经纪商受托买卖错帐及更正帐号处理作业要点》以经纪商名义开立的『错帐处理专户』处理：该专户买卖视同一般交易并按规定缴纳证券交易税，损益由经纪商承担；错误持仓在专户内平仓，原成交不撤销。事前防线：瞬间价格稳定措施（±3.5% 暂缓撮合 2 分钟，见 volatility_interruption）与每日涨跌幅限制

error_trade_rule.zh: 台湾证券交易所没有『成交价偏离参考价达某百分比、限时申请复核作废』的常规错误交易处理机制。买卖申报一经撮合成交，经纪商即通知委托人并制作凭证。证券经纪商受托买卖发生错误的，依营业细则以经纪商自己名义开立『错帐处理专户』处理——该专户买卖视同一般交易、按规定缴纳证券交易税，损益由经纪商承担，错误持仓在专户内平仓，原成交不予撤销
error_trade_rule.en: The TWSE has no routine erroneous-trade process of the US/EU type (a deviation threshold plus a time-limited request for review and cancellation). Once orders are matched, the broker notifies the client and prepares the records. Where a securities broker makes an execution error, it is handled under the Operating Rules through an 'error-account' opened in the broker's own name — trades in that account are treated as ordinary trades subject to securities transaction tax, gains and losses are borne by the broker, the erroneous position is closed out within the account, and the original trade is not cancelled
error_trade_rule.detail: 台湾证券交易所营业细则第 87 条 + 《证券经纪商受托买卖错帐及更正帐号处理作业要点》。与 trading_halt_mechanism（讯息面暂停）视角不同。resolution 记 no_bust：错误由经纪商端错帐专户承担，成交本身不作废。台湾与日本 / 香港证券市场同属『成交终局』一类。

error_trade_rule.quote: 證券經紀商因受託買賣發生錯誤，申報錯帳及更正帳號應依本公司訂定之「證券經紀商受託買賣錯帳及更正帳號處理作業要點」規定辦理。證券經紀商應以自己名義開立錯帳處理專戶，並編列帳號填註其公司營利事業統一編號，於客戶分戶帳內設戶記載。錯帳處理專戶所為之買賣，視同一般交易按規定繳納證券交易稅

intraday_reversal.zh: 一般交割周期为T+2，但现股当日冲销交易（先买后卖自2014年1月6日、先卖后买自2014年6月30日起开放）允许同一帐户同日买卖同种类同数量股票以差额净沖，不必等待T+2交割完成；沖销标的以公告之信用交易/当沖标的清单为限，非全市场无差别适用
intraday_reversal.en: Regular settlement is T+2, but same-day (day-trading) offsetting transactions in cash stock — buy-then-sell opened 6 Jan 2014, sell-then-buy opened 30 Jun 2014 — allow the same account to buy and sell the same class and quantity of shares on the same day and net the difference, without waiting for T+2 settlement; eligible securities are limited to the published margin-trading/day-trading-eligible list, not applied indiscriminately market-wide
intraday_reversal.detail: 官方称此机制为「当日沖销交易」（非「当日回转交易」），与本项目其余交易所惯用的T+0/T+1标签体系概念相通但正式名称不同，故 zh 字段保留 TWSE 官方用语。
intraday_reversal.quote: 自103年1月6日起投資人得以現股從事先買後賣之當日沖銷交易，並自103年6月30日開放先賣後買當日沖銷交易。

block_trade.zh: 鉅额交易：配对交易(08:00-08:30及09:00-17:00)与逐笔交易(09:00-17:00)两种方式；单一证券达500交易单位以上或金额达1,500万元以上，股票组合5种以上且总金额达1,500万元以上；采T+2交割

order_book_transparency.zh: 盘前：中央订单簿公开——开市前及收市前的一段时间即时揭示试算成交价与数量及试算未成交的最高五档买进、最低五档卖出申报价格与数量；交易时间内即时揭示成交价量及未成交的最高五档买进、最低五档卖出申报价量。集中市场不提供冰山 / 隐藏 / 未披露委托类型。盘中另有『瞬间价格稳定措施』限制价格跳动。盘后 / 大额：鉅额交易单独进行
order_book_transparency.en: Pre-trade: the central order book is public — for a period before the open and before the close the Exchange discloses in real time the trial matched price and quantity and the best five unmatched bid and best five unmatched ask prices and quantities; during trading hours it discloses executed prices and quantities and the best five unmatched bid/ask prices and quantities. The centralised market offers no iceberg, hidden or undisclosed order types. Block trades run separately
order_book_transparency.detail: 字段管本所订单簿内部的（非）展示流动性——集中市场订单簿五档揭示、无非展示订单类型。行情层级 / 收费见第十章 market_data_levels。quote 引自营业细则第 58-2 条。

listing_process_duration.zh: 官方页面列出七个步骤：申请公司提出申请→本公司承办人员查核→有价证券上市审议委员会及董事会审查→通过后转报金融监督管理委员会→委托证券承销商办理承销手续→向本公司洽定上市日期→正式挂牌买卖；但未见官方公开披露的标准总耗时（如「平均X个月」）数字。已确认的具体期限数据点：依《审查有价证券上市作业程序》第7-2条，免提报审议委员会审议之案件（如转板案件）经理部门应于收件后一个月内决议，因申请公司请求得延长一个月；另中央目的事业主管机关之评估意见函自发文之日起一年内有效，须于此期间内提出上市申请，逾期须重新申请
listing_process_duration.en: TWSE's official flow lists seven steps: application filed with TWSE, staff review, Listing Review Committee and Board review, referral to the Financial Supervisory Commission, underwriting by the lead securities underwriter, agreeing the listing date with TWSE, and formal listing — but no official aggregate duration figure (e.g. an average number of months) was found. Two concrete duration data points are confirmed: under Article 7-2 of the Listing Review Operating Procedures, the Handling Department must decide on cases exempted from Committee review (e.g. board-transfer applications) within one month of receipt, extendable by one further month at the applicant's request; separately, a central competent authority's evaluation opinion remains valid for one year from its issue date, within which the listing application must be filed or a fresh application is required
listing_process_duration.detail:
「总天数」这一综合数字本次未在 TWSE 官方来源中找到，本条目呈现的是官方原文确认的
流程步骤与两个局部时限数据点，而非端到端标准工期。若日后找到官方披露的整体平均耗时，
应回来补上并调高该部分的 confidence。
listing_process_duration.quote: 申請公司需向臺灣證券交易所提出申請 臺灣證券交易所承辦人員查核 臺灣證券交易所有價證券上市審議委員會及董事會審查 通過後轉報金融監督管理委員會 委託證券承銷商辦理承銷手續 向臺灣證券交易所洽定上市日期 正式掛牌買賣／第 7-2 條 依前條免提報審議委員會審議案件於收件後一個月內由經理部門決議，但遇有特殊情形者……因申請公司之請求而延長之審查期限以一個月為限。／申請公司應於前項中央目的事業主管機關之評估意見函發文之日起一年內提出上市之申請，逾期則應向本公司重新申請之。

transfer_between_boards.en: Before applying to list on the Main Board or the Taiwan Innovation Board, a domestic issuer must generally first have its shares registered and traded on the Emerging Stock (Rotan) market for at least 6 months before TWSE will accept the listing application, unless it is already OTC-listed on the Taipei Exchange (TPEx) or is a state-run enterprise (exemptions or shortened periods apply in cases such as being a subsidiary of an already-listed company)

continuing_obligations.zh: 依《证券交易法》第36条，上市公司须定期公告并申报财务与营运信息：年度财务报告须于每会计年度终了后三个月内完成，第一、二、三季财务报告须于季度终了后四十五日内完成，每月并须于次月十日前公告申报上月营运情形；股东常会须于每会计年度终了后六个月内召开。另须依《对有价证券上市公司重大讯息之查证暨公开处理程序》即时揭露重大讯息（见 disclosure_requirements 字段）
continuing_obligations.en: Under Securities and Exchange Act Article 36, a listed company must periodically disclose: an annual financial report within three months after each fiscal year-end, first/second/third-quarter reports within forty-five days after each quarter-end, and a monthly operating report by the tenth day of the following month; an annual shareholders' meeting must be convened within six months after each fiscal year-end. It must also make immediate material-information disclosures under TWSE's Material Information Verification and Disclosure Procedures (see disclosure_requirements)
continuing_obligations.detail: 与 disclosure_requirements 字段引用同一份重大讯息处理程序，但本字段聚焦上市公司须履行哪些持续性申报义务本身（定期财报＋即时重大讯息＋股东会），disclosure_requirements 聚焦揭露渠道/时限/语言要求，两者不重复。
continuing_obligations.quote: 第 36 條 已依本法發行有價證券之公司，除情形特殊，經主管機關另予規定者外，應依下列規定公告並向主管機關申報：一、於每會計年度終了後三個月內，公告並申報由董事長、經理人及會計主管簽名或蓋章，並經會計師查核簽證、董事會通過及監察人承認之年度財務報告。二、於每會計年度第一季、第二季及第三季終了後四十五日內，公告並申報……財務報告。三、於每月十日以前，公告並申報上月份營運情形。……股票已在證券交易所上市或於證券商營業處所買賣之公司股東常會，應於每會計年度終了後六個月內召開

suspension_resumption.zh: 上市公司出现财报未如期申报、净值低于实收资本额二分之一等多类情事之一，先列为「变更交易方法」证券（类似其他市场的处置/风险警示机制）；情形未改善或涉及无法表示意见/否定意见之查核报告、重大讯息违规等更严重情事，本公司依《证券交易法》相关规定停止其买卖并报请金管会备查，改善后得公告恢复买卖
suspension_resumption.en: A listed company that fails to file its financial report on schedule, whose net worth falls below half its paid-in capital, or that meets one of several other statutory triggers, is first designated a 'changed trading method' security (similar to a disposal/risk-alert flag on other markets); if the issue is not resolved, or more serious matters arise — such as a disclaimer or adverse audit opinion, or a material-information violation — TWSE suspends trading under the relevant Securities and Exchange Act provisions and reports it to the FSC for the record, with trading resumable by announcement once the issue is remedied
suspension_resumption.quote: 上市公司有下列情事之一者，對其上市之有價證券應由本公司依證券交易法第一百四十七條規定停止其買賣，並報請主管機關備查；或得由該上市公司依第五十條之一第五項規定申請終止上市。

delisting_conditions.zh: 《营业细则》第五十条之一规定十九款终止上市法定情事，本公司应终止其上市并报请主管机关备查。其中主要量化门槛包括：最近期财务报告显示净值为负数者；上市特别股发行总额低于新台币二亿元或发行股数低于二千万股者；依第五十条规定停止买卖连续满六个月仍未恢复其买卖者；营业全面停顿六个月无法恢复，或连续六个月公告之营业收入为零或负数者；为另一已上市（柜）公司持有股份逾其已发行股份总数或实收资本额百分之七十以上者；自上市挂牌日起届满一年后该股票已在证券柜台买卖中心上柜者。此外还包括公司经裁定解散、宣告破产确定、裁定准予重整确定等公司主体消灭情事，以及经主管机关命令停止全部有价证券买卖达三个月以上等重大违规情事，合计十九款，全文见 quote
delisting_conditions.en: Business Operation Rules Article 50-1 sets out nineteen statutory grounds on which TWSE must terminate a company's listing and report it to the regulator. Key quantitative triggers include: negative net worth per the most recent financial report; total issued preferred stock below New Taiwan dollars two hundred million, or fewer than twenty million shares; a trading suspension under Article 50 that remains unresolved for six consecutive months; a full business halt for six months with no resumption, or reported operating revenue at zero or negative for six consecutive months; more than seventy percent of issued shares or paid-in capital held by another listed/OTC-listed company; and remaining OTC-listed for over one year after the TWSE listing date. Other grounds include company dissolution, bankruptcy, or court-approved reorganization, and a regulator-ordered suspension of all securities trading lasting three months or more
delisting_conditions.quote: 或得由該上市公司依第五十條之一第五項規定申請終止上市。第50-1條上市公司有下列情事之一者，本公司對其上市之有價證券，應依證券交易法第一百四十四條規定終止其上市，並報請主管機關備查：……六、其上市特別股發行總額低於新台幣二億元或發行股數低於二千萬股者。……九、依證券交易法第三十六條規定公告並申報之最近期財務報告顯示其淨值為負數者。……十、公司營業全面停頓六個月無法恢復或連續六個月公告之營業收入為零或負數者。……十五、為另一已上市（櫃）之公司持有股份逾其已發行股份總數或實收資本額百分之七十以上者。……十八、自上市掛牌日起屆滿一年後，該股票已在櫃檯買賣中心上櫃者。

delisting_process.zh: 分阶段处理：先依《营业细则》第四十九条列为「变更交易方法有价证券」（类似其他市场的ST/风险警示处置）；情节持续或加重者，依第五十条规定停止其买卖，并报请主管机关备查；停止买卖后仍未改善，或触及第五十条之一所列十九款法定情事之一者（如净值转负、停止买卖满六个月未恢复、营业全面停顿满六个月、被另一已上市公司持股逾实收资本额百分之七十等），本公司终止其上市，并报请主管机关备查
delisting_process.en: A staged process: a security is first designated as a 'changed trading method' security under Business Operation Rules Article 49 (similar to an ST/risk-alert flag on other markets); if the issue persists or worsens, trading is suspended under Article 50 and reported to the regulator; if still unresolved, or if one of the nineteen statutory grounds under Article 50-1 is met (e.g. negative net worth, a suspension unresolved for six consecutive months, a full six-month business halt, or over seventy percent of shares held by another listed company), TWSE terminates the listing and reports it to the regulator
delisting_process.quote: 第49條上市公司有下列情事之一者，本公司對其上市之有價證券得列為變更交易方法有價證券：……第50條上市公司有下列情事之一者，對其上市之有價證券應由本公司依證券交易法第一百四十七條規定停止其買賣，並報請主管機關備查；或得由該上市公司依第五十條之一第五項規定申請終止上市。……第50-1條上市公司有下列情事之一者，本公司對其上市之有價證券，應依證券交易法第一百四十四條規定終止其上市，並報請主管機關備查：……六、其上市特別股發行總額低於新台幣二億元或發行股數低於二千萬股者。……九、依證券交易法第三十六條規定公告並申報之最近期財務報告顯示其淨值為負數者。……十、公司營業全面停頓六個月無法恢復或連續六個月公告之營業收入為零或負數者。……十五、為另一已上市（櫃）之公司持有股份逾其已發行股份總數或實收資本額百分之七十以上者。

delisting_transition_period.zh: 台湾未见与沪深『退市整理板』同类的统一整理期制度；已确认的官方安排局限于自愿终止上市个案：依《上市公司申请有价证券终止上市处理程序》，本公司董事会核议通过后，须于实施日二十日前公告；同时，同意终止上市决议之董事须负连带责任，承诺以不低于股东会╱董事会决议日前一个月股价简单算术平均数孰高者、且不低于每股净值之价格，于五十日收购期间内收购公司股票，收购期间届满后办理交割。因触及《营业细则》第五十条之一列举法定情事而被强制终止上市者，本次未见与自愿终止上市案件相同的固定天数整理期条文
delisting_transition_period.en: No unified delisting-transition-period regime analogous to the Shanghai/Shenzhen exchanges' dedicated delisting-transition board was found. The only confirmed official mechanism applies to voluntary delistings: under the Procedures for Handling a Listed Company's Application to Terminate the Listing of its Securities, TWSE's Board must announce the delisting at least twenty days before it takes effect, and the directors who voted for the resolution are jointly liable to buy back the company's shares — at a price no lower than the higher of the one-month simple average closing price before the shareholders'/board resolution date, or the most recent per-share net asset value — over a mandatory fifty-day buyback period, with settlement after the period ends. For forced delistings triggered by the statutory grounds in the Business Operation Rules, no equivalent fixed-day transition-period provision was found this session
delisting_transition_period.quote: 上市公司申請有價證券終止上市案經本公司董事會核議通過後，由本公司於實施日二十日前公告之，並即通知該上市公司。／前項收購起始日為終止上市之日，收購期間應為五十日，且應於收購期間屆滿後辦理交割，收購價格不得低於股東會決議日或董事會決議日前一個月股票收盤價之簡單算術平均數之孰高者，且不得低於該公司最近期經會計師查核或核閱財務報告之每股淨值。

post_delisting_venue.zh: 官方原文仅明确规定两类特定情形的下市后去向：(a) 已上市之可转换公司债申请终止上市，得转往证券柜台买卖中心(TPEx)买卖，且不受终止上市须经股东会特别决议之限制；(b) 第一上市（外国公司来台第一上市）股票，自终止上市日起同日亦停止公开发行（金管会民国111年10月13日公告委托本公司办理，自111年10月15日起实施）。本国普通股下市后是否登录兴柜或列为管理股票等一般去向，本次检索官方原文未见统一明文规定，留待后续核实（见 OPEN-QUESTIONS）
post_delisting_venue.en: TWSE's own rule texts confirm the post-delisting venue for two specific categories only: (a) a listed convertible bond applying to terminate its listing may transfer to trading on the Taipei Exchange (TPEx), exempted from the shareholders'-meeting special-resolution requirement otherwise applicable to voluntary delistings; (b) a Secondary-Listed (foreign) company's shares also cease to be publicly offered on the same day their listing terminates, per an FSC notice dated 13 October ROC 111 (2022) delegating this matter to TWSE, effective from 15 October ROC 111. No unified official statement on the general post-delisting venue for ordinary domestic common shares (e.g. whether they move to the Emerging Stock market or are designated 'managed stock') was found this session (see OPEN-QUESTIONS)
post_delisting_venue.quote: 但如係已上市之可轉換公司債，申請終止上市而轉往櫃檯買賣中心買賣者，得不受此限。（上市公司申請有價證券終止上市處理程序第2條）／金融監督管理委員會111年10月13日金管證字第11101415943號公告，委託本公司「辦理停止第一上市公司股票公開發行相關事宜，並自中華民國111年10月15日實施」（終止上市公司頁附註）

account_opening_requirements.zh: 依《台湾证券交易所股份有限公司证券经纪商受托契约准则》第3条，证券经纪商与委托人签订受托契约前须先完成开户：自然人委托人原则上须亲持身分证正本，当场签章办理开户并留存身分证影本，另须留存印鉴卡或签名样式卡以凭同式印鉴或签名办理委托买卖与交割相关手续；法人委托人须由被授权人检附法人登记证明文件、税捐机构统一编号通知单、授权书暨代表人与被授权人身分证影本办理；委托人并须先开设有价证券集中保管帐户及在指定金融机构开立存款帐户，方得受托买卖（部分境外华侨及外国人、信托业等身分依规定得以匯撥方式收付价金者除外）；另依第3-1条，开户须检附金融机构防制洗钱办法规定辨识身分之必要文件
account_opening_requirements.en: Under Article 3 of TWSE's Standards for Securities Brokers' Brokerage Agreements, a securities broker must complete account opening before signing a brokerage agreement: a natural-person client must generally appear in person with an original ID card, sign the agreement on the spot, and leave a photocopy of the ID, and must also register a seal or signature specimen used to authenticate every subsequent order and settlement instruction; a corporate client's authorized agent must submit the corporate registration certificate, the tax-authority withholding-unit registration notice, a power of attorney, and photo-ID copies of both the legal representative and the authorized agent; the client must also open a securities central depository account and a bank settlement account at a designated institution before the broker may accept orders (certain categories such as overseas Chinese/foreign investors and trust enterprises may remit funds by wire transfer instead). Article 3-1 additionally requires the documentation needed for anti-money-laundering identity verification at account opening
account_opening_requirements.quote: 委託人為自然人者，除下列情形外，應親持身分證正本並於受託契約當場簽章辦理開戶及留存身分證影本……委託人或其法定代理人或被授權人於簽訂受託契約時，應留存本人或其法定代理人或被授權人印鑑卡或簽名樣式卡，憑同式印鑑或簽名當面委託買賣、申購有價證券，或辦理交割相關手續。……證券經紀商應於委託人開設有價證券集中保管帳戶及在其指定之金融機構開立存款帳戶後，始得受其委託辦理買賣證券。／第 3-1 條 證券經紀商受理開戶，委託人應檢附金融機構防制洗錢辦法規定辨識身分之必要文件。

suitability_management.zh: 证券期货业提供『投资型』金融商品或服务前，依《金融服务业确保金融商品或服务适合金融消费者办法》第4条，须充分了解客户身份、财务背景、所得与资金来源、风险偏好、过往投资经验等资料（KYC），并综合评估客户资金操作状况与专业能力、投资属性与风险承受度、服务合适性以核实商品适合度。惟本办法第5条所列适用商品以信托、衍生性商品、结构型商品、全权委托等『投资型』商品为主，明文排除受托买卖集中市场或柜台买卖市场交易之证券╱基金本身，故一般股票买卖之适当性管理另循证券经纪商开户徵信等既有机制（见 account_opening_requirements 字段），本次未见与本办法同等级的专章规定
suitability_management.en: Under Article 4 of the Regulations Governing the Suitability of Financial Products or Services Offered by Financial Service Enterprises, before offering an 'investment-type' financial product or service, a securities/futures enterprise must fully understand the customer's identity, financial background, income and source of funds, risk preference and past investment experience (KYC), and assess the customer's fund-management status and expertise, investment profile and risk tolerance, and service suitability. However, Article 5's list of covered products centres on trust, derivatives, structured and discretionary-management products, and explicitly excludes securities/funds traded on the centralized or over-the-counter market itself — so suitability management for ordinary stock trading instead relies on the securities broker's existing account-opening due-diligence mechanisms (see account_opening_requirements) rather than a dedicated chapter equivalent to this regulation
suitability_management.quote: 銀行業及證券期貨業提供投資型金融商品或服務，於訂立契約前，應充分瞭解金融消費者之相關資料，其內容至少應包括下列事項：……二、瞭解金融消費者審查原則：應訂定瞭解金融消費者審查作業程序，及留存之基本資料，包括金融消費者之身分、財務背景、所得與資金來源、風險偏好、過往投資經驗及簽訂契約目的與需求等……三、評估金融消費者投資能力：……（一）金融消費者資金操作狀況及專業能力。（二）金融消費者之投資屬性、對風險之瞭解及風險承受度。（三）金融消費者服務之合適性……第 5 條 前條所稱投資型金融商品或服務……十、證券投資信託基金及境外基金。但不包括受託買賣集中市場或櫃檯買賣市場交易之證券投資信託基金。

market_data_levels.zh: TWSE未采用国际常见之『Level 1/Level 2』行情分级用语，而依《交易资讯使用管理办法》第3条自订以下分类：按时效分「即时资讯」「延迟资讯」（较即时资讯延迟二十分钟以上）「盘后资讯」三类；按连线方式分「直接连线」（与本公司电脑设备直接连线）与「间接连线」（经由其他申请使用者间接取得）；按用途分「揭示」与「非揭示」（不作揭示用途）。收费标准另将传输内容分为「即时交易资讯」与「即时指数资讯」（如TAIEX等系列指数）两大类商品。本次未见官方文件披露逐档报价深度（如五档╱十档）层级划分的对外说明
market_data_levels.en: TWSE does not use the internationally common 'Level 1/Level 2' market-data terminology. Instead, Article 3 of its Trading Information Usage Management Measures defines its own categories: by timeliness — 'real-time information', 'delayed information' (delayed twenty minutes or more relative to real-time) and 'post-market information'; by connection method — 'direct connection' (connected directly to TWSE's computer equipment) versus 'indirect connection' (obtained via another applicant); and by purpose — 'display use' versus 'non-display use'. Its fee schedule separately divides transmitted content into two product categories, 'real-time trading information' and 'real-time index information' (e.g. the TAIEX series). No official document was found this session disclosing an order-book depth tiering (e.g. five-level/ten-level quotes) equivalent to Level 1/2
market_data_levels.quote: 六、即時資訊與延遲資訊：市場交易時間中所傳送之交易資訊為即時資訊，較即時資訊延遲二十分鐘以上之交易資訊為延遲資訊。七、盤後資訊：市場交易時間以後所傳播之當日證券行情資訊為盤後資訊。八、直接連線與間接連線：申請使用者直接與本公司電腦設備連線取得交易資訊為直接連線，申請使用者經由其他申請使用者間接取得交易資訊為間接連線。……十、非揭示：指使用交易資訊不作揭示用途。／貳、即時指數資訊：一、臺灣證券交易所發行量加權股價指數（TAIEX）等系列指數

liquidity_risk_note.zh: 台湾并无与沪深『退市整理板』同类的独立市场，但设有『注意╱处置』交易资讯揭露机制：个股符合成交价振幅、周转率异常等标准且连续╱累计达一定营业日数者，本公司即公告其为『处置有价证券』，对该股票以人工管制之撮合终端机执行撮合（约每2分钟撮合一次，视处置次数与情节可延长至约每六十分钟一次），并要求证券商就投资人委托收足全额价金或证券（含信用交易自备款╱保证金），必要时另限缩各证券商每日买卖申报金额上限（总公司不逾新台币6千万元、分支机构不逾1千万元）、暂停融资融券。处置期间该股票之流动性与撮合频率将明显低于正常交易时段，是本地市场结构性的流动性风险来源之一
liquidity_risk_note.en: Taiwan has no independent market segment equivalent to the Shanghai/Shenzhen exchanges' dedicated delisting-transition board, but operates an 'Attention/Disposal' securities disclosure mechanism: a stock that meets abnormal price-swing or turnover-rate thresholds for a specified number of consecutive or cumulative trading days is announced as a 'Disposal Security'. Its matching is then switched to a manually-controlled matching terminal (roughly every 2 minutes, extendable to roughly every sixty minutes depending on the number and severity of prior disposal designations), brokers must collect full payment or securities upfront from investors placing orders (including margin-trading own-funds/collateral), and — where necessary — each broker's daily order value is capped (sixty million New Taiwan dollars per head office, ten million New Taiwan dollars per branch) and margin trading is suspended. During a Disposal period, the stock's liquidity and matching frequency fall well below normal trading levels, making this a structural source of liquidity risk in the local market

liquidity_risk_note.quote: 本公司於每日收盤後，即分析上市有價證券……發現有下列情形之一時，公告其交易資訊……有價證券之交易有下列情形之一時，本公司即發布為處置之有價證券……本公司於次一營業日起五個營業日內，同時採行下列之措施：一、對該有價證券以人工管制之撮合終端機執行撮合作業（約每二分鐘撮合一次……）。二、通知各證券經紀商……應就其當日已委託之買賣，向該投資人收取全部之買進價金或賣出證券，信用交易部分，則收足融資自備款或融券保證金……各證券商每日買進或賣出該有價證券之申報金額，總公司不得超過新臺幣六千萬元，每一分支機構不得超過新臺幣一千萬元……暫停該有價證券融資融券交易。／臺灣證券交易所股份有限公司公布或通知注意交易資訊暨處置作業要點（115.08.03）

enforcement_note.zh: 《证券交易法》第155条禁止操纵市场行为（如意图抬高╱压低价格通谋买卖、连续高买低卖影响市场秩序、散布流言或不实资料等）；第157条之1禁止内线交易（公司董监事、经理人、持股逾10%股东、职务上获悉消息之人等，于重大消息公开前后十八小时内买卖该公司股票）；违反上述规定者，依第171条处3年以上10年以下有期徒刑，得併科新台币1千万元以上2亿元以下罚金，若犯罪所得达新台币1亿元以上，加重至7年以上有期徒刑，併科2千5百万元以上5亿元以下罚金；金管会并得对违规行为人为吊销、停止或限制证券执业资格等行政处分
enforcement_note.en: Securities and Exchange Act Article 155 prohibits market manipulation (e.g. collusive trading intended to raise or depress prices, continuous high-buy/low-sell activity affecting market order, or spreading rumours or false information); Article 157-1 prohibits insider trading by company directors, supervisors, managers, shareholders holding over 10%, and persons who learn material information through their position, from trading the company's stock within eighteen hours before or after the material information becomes public. Violations are punishable under Article 171 by three to ten years' imprisonment plus a fine of NT$10 million to NT$200 million; where illicit gains reach NT$100 million or more, the penalty increases to at least seven years' imprisonment plus a fine of NT$25 million to NT$500 million. The FSC may additionally impose administrative sanctions such as revoking, suspending, or restricting a person's qualification to engage in the securities business
enforcement_note.quote: 第 155 條 對於在證券交易所上市之有價證券，不得有下列各款之行為：……三、意圖抬高或壓低集中交易市場某種有價證券之交易價格，與他人通謀……四、……連續以高價買入或以低價賣出……六、意圖影響集中交易市場有價證券交易價格，而散布流言或不實資料。／第 157-1 條 下列各款之人，實際知悉發行股票公司有重大影響其股票價格之消息時，在該消息明確後，未公開前或公開後十八小時內，不得……自行或以他人名義買入或賣出：一、該公司之董事、監察人、經理人……二、持有該公司之股份超過百分之十之股東。……／第 171 條 有下列情事之一者，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣一千萬元以上二億元以下罰金：一、違反第二十條第一項、第二項、第一百五十五條第一項、第二項、第一百五十七條之一第一項或第二項規定。……犯前項之罪，其因犯罪獲取之財物或財產上利益金額達新臺幣一億元以上者，處七年以上有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣二千五百萬元以上五億元以下罰金。
